svg.title: Гакк-приседания одной ногой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Single-leg hack squat, side three-quarter view, using a true inclined hack squat machine: broad stationary lower footplate on floor base, and movable back pad with shoulder yokes on 45 degree rails. Athlete is standing against the sled with shoulders under yokes and back contacting pad, face away from back pad. ONE working foot flat on stationary footplate. The other leg is bent and held off footplate, clearly no weight on that foot. Left: sled high, supporting leg nearly straight. Right: sled has moved diagonally down, supporting knee bent into squat and same foot still on the fixed plate. Both hands hold the yoke handles. Never show a leg press or free barbell. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
